questions.Q7.0: For iTransformer and DLinear trained inside the released QDF code, in which (dataset, horizon) cells does QDF reproduce a gain over its paired Sigma = I control (this defines the analysis cells)?
questions.Q7.1: In those cells, does the closed-form plug-in Sigma = I + a*S0n with validation-selected a recover the QDF gain?
questions.Q7.2: Is the residual second moment better than the label covariance?
questions.Q7.3: Do the eigen-directions matter, not only the spectrum?

backbone_hyperparameters.source: official backbone scripts, see research_notes/v5_inputs.md (thuml/iTransformer @ c2426e68, cure-lab/LTSF-Linear @ 0c113668); the QDF release has no iTransformer/DLinear scripts
backbone_hyperparameters.iTransformer: e_layers 3, d_model 512, d_ff 512, n_heads 8, dropout 0.1, factor 1, gelu, timeF embedding, instance normalisation (always on in QDF's models/iTransformer.py, = official use_norm True); ECL lr 5e-4 batch 16; Weather lr 1e-4 batch 32; train_epochs 10, patience 3, lradj type1
backbone_hyperparameters.DLinear: moving_avg 25, individual 0 (shared); ECL lr 1e-3 batch 16; Weather lr 1e-4 batch 16; train_epochs 10, patience 3, lradj type1. Deviation: seq_len 96 instead of the official 336, to match the rest of this study and QDF's own DLinear baseline (QDF Table 6, history 96). QDF's models/DLinear.py initialises weights to 1/seq_len (TSLib style), the LTSF-Linear release uses the PyTorch default; kept as released by QDF.
backbone_hyperparameters.common: seq_len 96, label_len 48, features M, test_batch_size 1, num_workers 0

qdf_hyperparameters: meta_lr, warmup_steps, num_tasks, meta_inner_steps per (dataset, pred_len) from the QDF release's TQNet scripts (scripts/{ECL,Weather}.sh at eb0693a9, = run_grid_v5.HP); inner_lr = the backbone learning rate (the release always sets inner_lr = learning_rate); first_order 1, overlap_ratio 0, max_norm 5.0, rec_lambda 1.0. QDF's paper tuned N_in, K, eta and lr for its iTransformer results (Fig. 3, values not released); v7 does not tune, so a missing QDF effect here is a statement about QDF with transferred settings only.
data: the v5 files already on the host: weather.csv (sha256 9b2b19b1...) and electricity.csv (sha256 7e45845d...) from hf-mirror AutonLab/Timeseries-PILE forecasting/autoformer. (The TSLib HF weather.csv has a different sha256, 34ee981d...; not used, so that v5 and v7 share the same file.)

excluded_cells.ECL-720: one ECL-720 job needs about 38 GB resident memory (QDF's itertools.cycle cache), so jobs can only run one at a time; same exclusion as v5.

a_grid_rationale: half-decade spacing; covers every validation-selected a in v3-v5 (0.01-0.5) and most oracle a values (v4 ETTh oracle a = 2 lies outside)

stages.A: all 6 cells x 5 seeds, arms QDF, SIGMA_I, PLUGIN_A<a> for a in a_grid (7 arms, 210 runs), plus SIGMA_I_REP for rep_seed in each cell (6 runs).
stages.B: only after stage A is complete, only in the analysis cells: COVY_A<a> for a in a_grid and SPECTRUM_RANDOM (6 arms x 5 seeds per analysis cell). If no cell qualifies, stage B is not run.

arms.QDF: released QDF (meta-learned Sigma) with the backbone above
arms.SIGMA_I: same command with --meta_lr 0 (Sigma stays I; shares initialisation, meta-phase RNG consumption and batch order with QDF)
arms.SIGMA_I_REP: exact repeat of SIGMA_I at rep_seed, GPU run-to-run noise
arms.PLUGIN_A<a>: as protocol_v3/v5: Sigma = I + a*S0n injected after the (meta_lr 0) meta phase, S0 = training-set second moment of the initial residual, S0n = S0*T/tr(S0)
arms.PLUGIN_VAL: lowest best validation MSE over the 5 PLUGIN_A<a> runs, ties to the smaller a; test MSE never used
arms.COVY_A<a>: as protocol_v4/v5 (Sigma = I + a*Cyn, Cyn = Cov(Y_train)*T/tr)
arms.SPECTRUM_RANDOM: as protocol_v4/v5: eigenvalues of I + a*S0n with Haar-random eigenvectors (rotation seeded by the run seed), a = the per-seed PLUGIN_VAL a; matched comparator PLUGIN_A<same a>, same seed

quantities.R_X: mean g_X / mean g_QDF per cell

analysis_cells: a cell is an analysis cell iff g_QDF > 0 for >= min_pos of 5 seeds and mean g_QDF >= max(0.005, 3*nu). Fixed from stage A before stage B is launched; other cells are reported descriptively.

decision_rules.min_pos_rationale: with 5 seeds, every 'for all seeds' rule of v5 (3/3) becomes '>= 4/5', tolerating one discordant seed; the magnitude thresholds are unchanged
decision_rules.scope: verdicts are computed separately for each backbone (its own n and k) and once pooled over all analysis cells; the per-backbone verdicts are primary
decision_rules.k: with n analysis cells, k = ceil(2n/3); n < 2 gives INSUFFICIENT_CELLS

Q7.1.META_LEARNING_UNNECESSARY_GENERALISES: in >= k analysis cells: R_PLUGIN_VAL >= 0.8 and g_PLUGIN_VAL > 0 for >= min_pos seeds

Q7.2.LABEL_COV_EQUIVALENT: in >= k analysis cells: R_COVY_VAL >= 0.8 and |mean D_label| <= 0.25 * mean g_QDF
Q7.2.RESIDUAL_BETTER: in >= k analysis cells: mean D_label > 0.25 * mean g_QDF and D_label > 0 for >= min_pos seeds
Q7.2.LABEL_BETTER: in >= k analysis cells: mean D_label < -0.25 * mean g_QDF and D_label < 0 for >= min_pos seeds

Q7.3.STRUCTURE_MATTERS: in >= k analysis cells: R_SPECTRUM_RANDOM < 0.5 and D_struct > 0 for >= min_pos seeds

decision_rules.order: Q7.2 rules are checked in the listed order (as v4/v5)
decision_rules.secondary: per cell: g_QDF per seed, nu, every PLUGIN_A<a> and COVY_A<a> R with bands RECOVERS (>= 0.8) / PARTIAL / FAILS (< 0.5), selected vs oracle a, cos(S0, Cy), run times; descriptive cells reported with the same table but no verdict. TQNet on the same cells is available from v5 (3 seeds, 7-point grid) and is compared descriptively only.

code: run_grid_v7.py (--stage A|B, --smoke DIR), fixed_sigma_patch.py (as installed for v6; only plugin_abs, covy_abs and spectrum_random are used), summarize_v7.py -> results/summary_v7.json; runs appended to results/runs_v7.jsonl, work dirs runs_v7/.
integrity: all runs (including failures) appended to results/runs_v7.jsonl; failures rerun only through the resumable runner; verdicts only from summarize_v7.py; anything else is a new, post hoc labelled analysis.
